children: Kimberly Logan is scheduled to share further details on VAA at Sui Basecamp on 07 Oct 2026. The VAA Basecamp update covers a use case in which Walrus stores independently verifiable AI-agent proofs while the underlying data remains private in Google Cloud.

The arrangement separates proof storage from the storage of private underlying data. Walrus provides the storage layer for proofs that can be independently verified, while Google Cloud holds the underlying data privately. This is a confirmed enterprise proof-storage use case for Walrus. The available information does not establish which additional details the session will disclose or their effect on adoption.
